raglight.title: RAGLight — File Knowledge Bank & Provisioner
raglight.description: Connect to an existing RAGLight server (local or cloud) or auto-provision a managed local RAGLight instance to index folders on your machine for Aura.
raglight.enableDescription: Automatically retrieve relevant local file excerpts when chatting with Aura.
raglight.modeExternalUrl: Connect to existing RAGLight (Local or Cloud)
raglight.noFoldersSelected: No folders selected yet. RAGLight never scans your entire drive — only folders you explicitly add here.
raglight.guideTitle: How the file bank works (for any user)
raglight.guideStep1: 1. Pick a free local provider (Ollama) or a paid cloud provider (OpenAI, Gemini, Mistral) below.
raglight.guideStep2: 2. Add only the folders you want Aura to know about (studies, projects, notes).
raglight.guideStep3: 3. Click Install & Provision (sets up an isolated Python environment on Windows/Linux/macOS) and then Index folders.

hindsight.title: Hindsight — Episodic Memory Brain & Maintenance
hindsight.description: Manages personal memories, evolving preferences (superseding outdated facts), and automatic daily consolidation. Cross-platform for Windows, macOS, and any Linux distro.
hindsight.enableDescription: Retains conversation/task milestones and injects relevant memories into Aura responses.
hindsight.autoBanksDescription: Aura autonomously creates isolated banks (work, studies, finance, hobbies) as needed.
hindsight.dailyMaintenanceDescription: Runs memory consolidation and SQLite optimization once per day in the background.
hindsight.testRecallPlaceholder: Query what Aura remembers about you...
hindsight.guideTitle: First-time setup guide (Windows, Linux, and macOS)
hindsight.guideBody: Even without Hindsight installed, Aura works out of the box using the built-in SQLite memory store. To enable the full Hindsight daemon with Mental Models & memory graphs: 1) Configure an AI model (local Ollama or online API key); 2) Click Install local Hindsight (isolated Python/uv inside your user data folder); 3) Click Start daemon.
